evidence: SOURCE-CONFIRMED requirement-coverage gap. All task-relative citations below refer to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r1/task/. environment/instructions/integration.md:11 explicitly says "Start with an empty saved library; users create their own snippets." environment/assets/seed_data.json:2-3 supplies snippets=[] and repeats that the saved library starts empty. No criterion owns this initial-state requirement. The only pre-write Render criterion says merely "An empty saved library is valid" (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23), and its prompt:14-19 restricts grading to the basic authored Run. Constraints immediately creates its record while leaving existing records intact (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29) and explicitly says not to require an exact total library count. All later dimensions intentionally tolerate earlier saved mutations (tests/app_context.md:24; functional/prompt.md:19); S22 preserves the whole actually observed collection, including any unwanted startup records (functional/prompt.md:429-430). Thus the mandatory clean-start state has no scored or gate observation, rather than being safely covered by a shared flow. Independently parsed all five TOMLs: 80 functional outcomes in 22 named protocols, 6 Polish, 6 Visual, and one criterion in each gate. Other public product requirements have identifiable owners: language dispatch/freshness S02 and S04; completed interaction/Stop/actual last-good pictures S03/S04/S10; cancellation and deadlines S04/S09/S36; isolation/network/unsupported execution S05/S07/S08; errors and source lines S03/S10-S13; console and durations S14-S16; Auto-run and document switching S17; editor basics S19; exact records/reload/text-only storage S21; conflicting saves and retained drafts S23; history/inspection/restore/lost-reply retry/stale restore S37; simultaneous writes S38; records/history/retry across process restart S22; narrow-screen panes/labels/focus/keyboard history navigation and readable presentation Polish/Visual. The Node/Express/SQLite restrictions are inherited from the frozen template integration.md:3-14; browser observations do not prove those implementation details, and this review does not propose changing shared harness policy or source-reading to address them. Conforming-alternative challenge: an actually empty starting library with no examples, a tabbed/mobile workspace, arbitrary labels and routes, and static restored pictures remains accepted by the written gates and mapped criteria. The proposed initial-state fix must occur before any gate save so that a conforming populated continuing database is never falsely failed. Verified 61 relevant frozen input/policy hashes against manifest.json with zero mismatches, including every inspected prompt/criterion file; independently verified all 21 raw-evidence-index artifact hashes with zero mismatches. The indexed artifacts are scripted product evidence only; no configured judge, weak-app run, Oracle/model score or portal result was claimed or needed to establish this textual omission.
counterexample: A fully working conforming playground except for one idempotently seeded, durable saved snippet titled "Welcome demo" on a fresh database. It supports all 80 functional outcomes and all usability/visual outcomes. Render explicitly allows ordinary populated state, Constraints creates and loads its unique unrelated gate record without requiring an initial count, and S22 simply verifies that the demo survives alongside the measured records. The app therefore violates integration.md:11 but has no written criterion to lose for that violation. This is a source-level counterexample, not a measured app score.
suggested_fix: Give initial emptiness an explicit graded observation before the first gate Save, or revise the task-specific public initialization requirement to allow optional examples; keep later criteria tolerant of legitimate earlier mutations and do not change shared harness/scoring policy.
